C0647.title: Employee's Misdirected Email Leaks Trade Secrets; Shenzhen Longgang Court Rules Dismissal Lawful
C0647.summary: An employee at a Shenzhen-based company, surnamed Liang, inadvertently sent an email containing trade secrets of a partner company to an unintended recipient due to a work oversight, resulting in a trade secret leak.
